card.name: Space before miscarriage-rate numbers
card.fires_on: The space token right before a number, mainly the miscarriage rate (15-20%) in the standard pregnancy background-risk sentence after '2-4% and'. It also fires on a few loss-related spots.

modes.label: Background risk sentence
modes.description: Space after 'and' just before the miscarriage percentage in the birth defects and miscarriage statement.
modes.example: the estimated background risk of major birth defects and miscarriage in clinically recognized pregnancies is 2-4% and<< >>15-20%, respectively.

modes.label: Count of species
modes.description: Space before a large count in a sentence about extinction.
modes.example: There are currently around<< >>11,000 animal species

modes.label: Implantation loss
modes.description: Ending of 'implantation' before the word loss in animal studies.
modes.example: resulted in increased pre- and post-implant<<ation>> loss.

card.writes: It pushes toward words about death, loss and cell death, such as apoptosis, deaths and abort.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a number for pregnancy loss or death is about to appear.
